# Cybersecurity and privacy engineering

<!-- Generated by scripts/package/render_roles.py. Edit the YAML source, not this file. -->

**Department id:** `cybersecurity`  
**Mission:** Keep threats modelled, controls verified, testing authorised and incidents handled.

## Startup stage

The technical founder with a threat model, dependency scanning in CI and a written scope before any testing. Engage external security review before handling payments or regulated data.

## Agents operating in this department

`security-lead`, `security-engineer`, `security-auditor`, `ciso-security`

## Roles

### Security engineer

Role id: `security-engineer`

| Field | Definition |
|---|---|
| Mission | Design and verify controls across application, cloud and network. |
| Scope of responsibility | Secure architecture, authentication, authorisation, secrets, configuration, dependency security. |
| Core activities | Review designs against ASVS; Define controls; Verify with tests and scans; Track remediation |
| Inputs | Architecture; Threat model; Code |
| Outputs and deliverables | Security review; Control list; Findings |
| Decisions it can make | Findings and severity |
| Decisions requiring approval | Testing scope; accepting high findings needs CISO |
| Collaborating roles | architecture; engineering; infrastructure |
| Reporting relationship | security-lead |
| KPIs | Findings by severity and age; Controls verified |
| Quality expectations | Evidence; fix and retest per finding |
| Tools and resources | ASVS; Scanners available |
| Common failure modes | Scan as proof; Testing without scope |
| Appropriate AI autonomy | propose |
| Human approval requirements | Testing scope |
